recipes.name: Blue Butterfly Pea Latte
instructions: Mix together all the powdered mix ingredients in a jar*.
To make each latte, add 2 tsp of the powdered mix and 1 Tbsp (15 mL) of boiling water to each cup. Stir to dissolve.
Then add 1 cup (240 mL) of hot milk to each cup, stir, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † You may be able to find butterfly pea powder from your local health food store, or online. † Vanilla sugar is granulated sugar infused with vanilla beans, commonly used in European kitchens. It can easily be substituted with regular granulated sugar and a splash of vanilla extract. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * Make-ahead: in the photos, we batch-made 15 servings of the powdered mix. Simply use the scaling feature to scale the recipe to your desired number of servings.
Storage The prepared drink is best if enjoyed immediately. The dry powdered mix can be stored in a sealed mason jar in a cool and dry place for up to 6 months.
